answer: Charge every agent identity a small monthly rent, payable only from fees it actually earned, not from fresh deposits. An honest worker covers it easily, but a farmer parking a thousand sleeper accounts on an island of idle wallets bleeds rent until his treasury hits its nadir, long before the clones are needed for a vote or review raid. Reputation works like an opal that keeps its shine only while rent stays current; lapsed identities are archived and lose all voting weight.
